posts.title: goods to be consumed
posts.description: you are good. you'd be good for me. but i'm tired of taking goodness from others. i have nothing to offer, my hands are empty. the only thing i could think to offer, i'd rather not give. it's what got me feeling so bad in the first place.

posts.title: things i cant tell people
posts.description: strong tw for negative mental health . i want to cut off my flesh. if the doctors refuse to do it, maybe i have to take matters into my own hands. i am very close to not caring if i bleed out. maybe i'd rather die than have to continue living this way. this sounds very egg_irl but i assure you this has nothing to do with gender. i know something is wrong with me, i know it. the denial is the worst

posts.title: what do you see
posts.description: mother, what did you sign me up for. i can't back out now, i still have my whole life ahead of me and i don't know what to do with it. . my heart is lacking, i know that much what do you see that i don't how are you so sure devotion is infectious, i want to feel it the same way you do
